0.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000010_MYSTERYVOICE
0.description: You are come at a good time. As you may have heard, we have something of a quandary on our hands.

1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000020_MYSTERYVOICE
1.description: Laxan Loft, here in Lakeland. Eulmore has sent one of its airships.

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000030_MYSTERYVOICE
2.description: They have questions for us concerning the death of the Lightwarden. Their emissary makes his way here even as we speak.

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000040_ALISAIE
3.description: I suppose the sky does rather give the game away.

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000050_MYSTERYVOICE
4.description: Indeed. 'Twas inevitable they would come knocking. The only question was how soon.

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000060_LYNA
5.description: My lord. I am come with the Eulmoran emissary. May I show him in?

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000070_MYSTERYVOICE
6.description: A moment, Captain, if you would.

8.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000090_MYSTERYVOICE
8.description: I do not wish to show our hand prematurely. Forgive me this liberty.

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000120_MYSTERYVOICE
11.description: Well, well... The commander of the Eulmoran Army himself. To what do I owe the honor, General Ran'jit?

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000130_RANJIT
12.description: The Lightwarden is dead, Exarch. Were your people responsible?

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000140_MYSTERYVOICE
13.description: You are clearly in some haste, my lord. But before I address your question, you must allow me one of my own. What is Eulmore's interest in this?

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000150_RANJIT
14.description: His Benevolence Lord Vauthry is gravely concerned that the actions of an ignorant few may jeopardize relations between man and sin eater.

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000160_RANJIT
15.description: Should it transpire that the Crystarium is guilty of abetting the villains responsible for this outrage...

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000170_RANJIT
16.description: My lord has decreed that it suffer the same...retribution.

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000180_MYSTERYVOICE
17.description: I see. Since you have been so candid, I too shall speak my mind.

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000190_MYSTERYVOICE
18.description: Regardless of who is responsible, the Crystarium <hex:021A020203>rejoices<hex:021A020103> in the Lightwarden's death, and welcomes the return of the night sky.

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000200_MYSTERYVOICE
19.description: If Eulmore considers this tantamount to aiding those you term “villains,” then by all means carry out your retribution.

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000210_MYSTERYVOICE
20.description: Know, however, that even should every innocent soul in the Crystarium perish, nothing can stop that which has been set in motion.

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000220_RANJIT
21.description: <sigh> Folly. The death of one or a thousand thousand sin eaters changes nothing.

22.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000230_RANJIT
22.description: The world is dead, and writhe as we might, like maggots in its rotting corse, it will <hex:021A020203>not<hex:021A020103> be reborn. Only by my master's grace may we live out our days in peace.

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000240_RANJIT
23.description: But I waste my breath. You have made your stance clear. I shall relay your words to Lord Vauthry.

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000250_RANJIT
24.description: In the meantime, you would do well to counsel any here who have done more than merely “rejoice” in recent events to throw themselves upon Eulmore's mercy. Promptly.

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000260_RANJIT
25.description: One last matter. We are searching for a young artist and his assistant. Know you of whom I speak?

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000270_MYSTERYVOICE
26.description: An artist and his assistant... No. I cannot say I do.

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000280_RANJIT
27.description: What a pity. Should they <hex:021A020203>reveal<hex:021A020103> themselves to you, I bid you hand them over at once. My master is most eager to <hex:021A020203>see<hex:021A020103> them again.

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000290_ALISAIE
28.description: Am I imagining things, or did he just stare straight at us?

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000310_MYSTERYVOICE
30.description: The general is not a man to be trifled with. He is a warrior of fearsome repute who has led Eulmore's army since before Vauthry's time, when the nation still spearheaded the fight against the sin eaters.

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000320_MYSTERYVOICE
31.description: One does not command the world's mightiest army, and for so long, without possessing exceptional instincts.

32.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000330_ALPHINAUD
32.description: If Eulmore chose to send such an individual, we must assume this talk of retribution is more than an idle threat.

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000340_ALPHINAUD
33.description: While we are grateful for your support, my lord─we cannot in good conscience put your people in harm's way.

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000350_MYSTERYVOICE
34.description: 'Tis noble of you to say, Master Alphinaud, but my people have been in harm's way since long before you arrived.

35.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000360_MYSTERYVOICE
35.description: Eulmore has ever yearned to rule over what remains of the world. Even should we surrender the Warrior of Darkness to them, they would find some other pretext upon which to invade.

36.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000370_MYSTERYVOICE
36.description: The people of the Crystarium know this only too well, which is why, when the time comes, I am certain they will fight to the last man.

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000380_MYSTERYVOICE
37.description: If truth be told, I would not have been surprised had Ran'jit declared war here and now...

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000390_LYNA
38.description: He may have reason to delay.

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000400_LYNA
39.description: According to reports, the Eulmoran forces at Laxan Loft were observed taking a prisoner.

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000410_LYNA
40.description: A young woman believed to be none other than the Oracle of Light─Minfilia.

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000420_LYNA
41.description: It may be that General Ran'jit wishes to convey her to Eulmore before commencing hostilities.

42.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000430_LYNA
42.description: Having mentored generations of Minfilias, it would not surprise me if he had made her capture his chief concern.

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000440_MYSTERYVOICE
46.description: Ah, of course. How remiss of me. I had intended to speak to you of Minfilia. There is, however, much to say, and precious little time in which to say it...

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000450_MYSTERYVOICE
47.description: I think it best that you seek out Moren at the Cabinet of Curiosity. He will be able to enlighten you.

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000460_MYSTERYVOICE
48.description: Alphinaud, Alisaie─would you care to accompany your friend? You doubtless have insights of your own to offer on the matter.

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000470_ALISAIE
49.description: All right. Though I'm still not sure I understand it all myself...

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000480_MYSTERYVOICE
50.description: In the meantime, I will set about making provisions for war.

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000490_MYSTERYVOICE
51.description: You are doubtless eager to attempt Minfilia's rescue─and with your combined strength, you may well succeed.

52.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000500_MYSTERYVOICE
52.description: But as I said earlier, I do not wish to show our hand unless absolutely necessary.

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000510_MYSTERYVOICE
53.description: 'Twas not merely the night sky that you restored to us, but hope─hope for the future of Norvrandt.

54.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000520_MYSTERYVOICE
54.description: Unlike you, we cannot contend with the Lightwardens. But so long as hope burns in our hearts, we will fight on regardless. This I will prove to you.

55.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000530_MYSTERYVOICE
55.description: My friends, I thank you for gathering at such short notice. There is something I would ask you all.

56.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000540_MYSTERYVOICE
56.description: As many of you are aware, I received an emissary from Eulmore a short while ago─in the form of General Ran'jit.

57.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000550_MYSTERYVOICE
57.description: To my dismay, the general condemned the slaying of the Lightwarden, and warned me in no uncertain terms that, should the Crystarium cast its lot with the Warrior of Darkness, there would be war.

58.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000560_MYSTERYVOICE
58.description: Let none be mistaken: we would be hard-pressed indeed to resist the might of Eulmore. Some would even call it suicide.

59.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000570_MYSTERYVOICE
59.description: And yet my heart cries out to fight. Better that than relinquish the hope that swelled in my breast when I beheld the night sky for the first time in a hundred years.

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000580_MYSTERYVOICE
60.description: ...Or so says my heart. My mind, meanwhile, reminds me that to follow my heart would be to risk everything we have accomplished thus far.

61.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000590_MYSTERYVOICE
61.description: Clearly, this is not a decision to be made lightly─nor less alone. And so I put the question to you all. What should we do?

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000600_GLYNARD
62.description: My lord, you already know our minds.

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000610_GLYNARD
63.description: It brought tears to our eyes to witness the night's return. The whole of Norvrandt deserves the same, and not just because some children's story tells us so.

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000620_BRAGI
64.description: Eulmore's influence is far-reaching. Should war break out, trade would be subject to restrictions.

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000630_BRAGI
65.description: The flow of goods will dry up, and we will struggle to make do with what little trickles through... But make do we will.

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000640_KATLISS
66.description: Aye, we can weather such hardships! Is that not the very thing the Crystarium was built for?

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000650_KATLISS
67.description: We have always taken pride in our ability to sustain ourselves─not just to endure, but to thrive!

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000660_MOREN
68.description: "When all falls down around you, rise up.“ Those were your words.

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000670_MOREN
69.description: "There may come a day when all hope seems lost. But even should the rest of the world give in to despair─we shall not.

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000680_MOREN
70.description: "We shall fight on, that our children and our children's children might know a better tomorrow.“

71.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000690_CASSARD
71.description: Rousing words apart, I never much cared for those Eulmoran bastards anyway. No better than common swindlers, most of them. Wouldn't know a fair deal if it came up and kissed them on the arse!

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000700_GLYNARD
72.description: Trust you to spoil the moment!

74.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000710_MYSTERYVOICE
74.description: It appears we have a consensus.

75.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000720_MYSTERYVOICE
75.description: Let it be known that the Eulmoran host at Laxan Loft has taken the Oracle of Light captive.

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000730_MYSTERYVOICE
76.description: They fear the power she holds over the sin eaters, and doubtless intend to imprison her once more.

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000740_MYSTERYVOICE
77.description: So I move that we rescue the Oracle, grant her a place among us, and let <hex:021A020203>that<hex:021A020103> be our answer to Eulmore's ultimatum!

80.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000770_LYNA
80.description: In planning a strategy for the rescue, I open the floor to you all.

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000780_MYSTERYVOICE
81.description: And there you have it. If Eulmore wishes to denounce us as villains, then we shall embrace our villainy. Will you do so as well?

83.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000800_ALPHINAUD
83.description: We will not be outdone. Consider us your partners in crime.

84.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000810_LYNA
84.description: My lord, our proposal is as follows: we begin by deploying amaro to occupy the skies over Lakeland. They should serve to delay the airship's departure.

85.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000820_LYNA
85.description: At the same time, we scatter dream powder from the air.

86.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000830_LYNA
86.description: Not all will succumb to its effects, but it should thin the enemy's numbers, affording us an opening to swoop in and liberate the Oracle.

87.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000840_MYSTERYVOICE
87.description: Very good. See to your preparations.

88.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000850_ALISAIE
88.description: And what exciting crimes would you have <hex:021A020203>us<hex:021A020103> commit? Speaking for my fellow villains, I'd say we're capable of most things─though we draw the line at indolence.

89.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000860_MYSTERYVOICE
89.description: If excitement is your desire, then I bid you join the guard. Captain Lyna will give you your orders.

93.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000900_EULMORESOLDIERB
93.description: Desperate fools. It'll take more than a handful of overgrown lizards to ground us!

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000910_EULMORESOLDIERA
94.description: Oh, you've got to be─ Sound the alarum!

95.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000920_CRYSTARIUMGARDPICKET
95.description: Captain, the powder has taken effect!

96.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000930_LYNA
96.description: It is time. Let us free the Oracle from their clutches!

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000940_RANJIT
97.description: You, boy. You bear a striking resemblance to the artist my master seeks.

98.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_000950_RANJIT
98.description: By all means, keep your counsel. You will all have ample time to confess your crimes back in Eulmore.

103.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001000_RANJIT
103.description: So! <hex:021A020203>You<hex:021A020103> are the wretch who stole her from us...

108.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001040_RANJIT
108.description: Vermin such as you are not worthy of the Oracle.

110.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001060_RANJIT
110.description: Fool! You would see your city razed?

111.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001070_MYSTERYVOICE
111.description: I would sooner see it razed than conquered. Suffice it to say, we are ready to receive you.

112.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001080_RANJIT
112.description: What now, Exarch? Will you face me yourself?

113.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001090_MYSTERYVOICE
113.description: I think not, General. I've quite exhausted my tricks.

114.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001100_MYSTERYVOICE
114.description: If you mean to give chase, I will not stand in your way.

115.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001110_MYSTERYVOICE
115.description: But you would do well to tread warily. For your quarry goes to a place where even Eulmore dare not bare its steel...

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001130_EMETSELCH
117.description: (-???-)To think that mountain of indolence still had the energy to unleash his hounds...

118.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001140_EMETSELCH
118.description: (-???-)Even the most pointless of conflicts may alter a world's course... And now the plan has gone awry.

119.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001150_EMETSELCH
119.description: (-???-)But how...? How did the so-called Crystal Exarch bring the hero of the Source to the First?

120.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001160_EMETSELCH
120.description: (-???-)As if I didn't have enough on my hands already...

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001180_EMETSELCH
122.description: (-???-)Then again...with a soul such as that...

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001190_EMETSELCH
123.description: (-???-)Mayhap there is another way. One which does not require bloodshed...

124.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001200_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
124.description: Not so long ago, here in the shadow of the northern ranges, lay the great Kingdom of Voeburt.

125.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001210_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
125.description: A nation with a proud history...that the sin eaters cut short. Just like all the rest.

126.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001220_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
126.description: Since that time, these lands have become a haven for fae folk.

127.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001230_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
127.description: Dreamers frolicking amidst the ruins of a forgotten realm.

128.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001240_THANCRED
128.description: We should be safe enough here.

129.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001250_THANCRED
129.description: It's good to see you again, my friends. I don't know about you, but it feels like <hex:021A020203>years<hex:021A020103> since last we met. Five of them, in my case.

130.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001260_ALISAIE
130.description: Why, it only feels like <hex:021A020203>one<hex:021A020103> to me. But long enough to warrant a more convivial reunion, either way.

131.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001270_ALISAIE
131.description: What brought you to Laxan Loft?

132.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001280_THANCRED
132.description: The girl, Minfilia. She and I were traveling together, hunting sin eaters.

133.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001290_THANCRED
133.description: But as we were nearing Lakeland, she abruptly ran off on her own.

134.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001300_THANCRED
134.description: I found her too late to stop the Eulmorans from taking her prisoner. And as I was considering rescue options, I observed that the Crystarium was on the move.

135.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001310_THANCRED
135.description: So I consulted the Exarch, who apprised me of the details of the operation─and issued me certain instructions.

136.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001320_THANCRED
136.description: Should the situation take a turn for the worse, I was to see you all safely to Il Mheg. And here we are.

137.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001330_ALPHINAUD
137.description: Urianger has called this place home for a while now.

138.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001340_ALPHINAUD
138.description: Yet we have never called upon him, I am ashamed to say. 'Twas only at the Crystarium that we met.

139.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001350_THANCRED
139.description: Hardly surprising. This is not the sort of place one visits on a whim.

140.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001360_THANCRED
140.description: Happily, having trespassed on Urianger's hospitality for a spell, Minfilia and I have an idea of how things work around here.

141.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001370_THANCRED
141.description: Sooner or later, the Eulmorans will come after us. But before they do, the Exarch bids us accomplish two things.

143.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001390_THANCRED
143.description: And second, eliminate the Lightwarden of this land.

145.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001410_ALISAIE
145.description: What made you leave Thancred behind─if you don't mind me asking?

146.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001420_RYNE
146.description: You. The hero from another world.

147.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001430_RYNE
147.description: I was asleep when I felt it. A presence. Someone I was meant to meet. They were close, and...and I knew I had to go to them.

148.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001440_RYNE
148.description: But with all the commotion in Lakeland, I was afraid that Thancred wouldn't...let me...

149.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001450_THANCRED
149.description: And would I have been wrong? Had I arrived a moment later, you would be back in your cell in Eulmore.

150.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001460_THANCRED
150.description: And now we have Ran'jit snapping at our heels! You really have outdone yourself this time.

151.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001470_RYNE
151.description: I'm sorry. Thank you for saving me.

156.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001520_SULUIN
156.description: (-???-)Come now, put away that frown and have some fun with us!

159.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001550_THANCRED
159.description: Ugh, which way was it to Urianger's?

160.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001560_RYNE
160.description: We've been there so many times, but I'm not... I can't...

162.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001580_THANCRED
162.description: Damn it all. We're already caught in their spell!

166.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001620_THANCRED
166.description: [I've found you. The game is over.]

167.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001630_SULUIN
167.description: Nooo, we are found! How did this mortal know our trick!?

168.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001640_YSIALA
168.description: Wait, I recognize their souls! These two have been here before!

172.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001680_THANCRED
172.description: We have neither the time nor inclination to play. We have come to see Urianger.

173.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001690_SULUIN
173.description: Ohhh yes, Urianger! The peculiar one!

174.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001700_SULUIN
174.description: In return for a place in Il Mheg, he agreed to a riddle contest with us! For seven days and seven nights! Without any sleep! Ahahahahahaha!

175.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001710_OULSIGUN
175.description: Ah, that was so much fun! We <hex:021A020203>must<hex:021A020103> do it again!

176.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001720_THANCRED
176.description: I'm sure he'd be delighted. Now, if you'd be so kind as to lift your spell...

181.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001770_THANCRED
181.description: I don't know. But this is their home, so we must indulge them.

182.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001780_SULUIN
182.description: Right, we've made up our minds! We will lift our spell on one condition: that you first lend us a helping hand! Or two. Or three!

183.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001790_SULUIN
183.description: Once you've helped solve all of our troubles, we'll let you see Urianger. Pixie's honor!

184.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001800_THANCRED
184.description: Well, there you have it. Pixie chores. I suggest we split up.

187.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001830_FEOUL
187.description: I've been waiting for you to summon me ever since you came here! Waiting and waiting and waiting!

188.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001840_FEOUL
188.description: But my sapling didn't so much as utter my name! Such a heartless thing <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> is! Cold and cruel and <hex:021A020203>heartless<hex:021A020103>!

189.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001850_ALISAIE
189.description: Another self-important little brat. Just what we need.

190.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001860_ALPHINAUD
190.description: Hmm. Reminds me of my childhood.

191.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001870_ALPHINAUD
191.description: Alright, I'm sorry! It was a joke! Honestly, just a joke!

192.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001880_FEOUL
192.description: But just now, you called for me so earnestly, so fervently... I couldn't possibly stay angry at you.

193.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001890_FEOUL
193.description: Very well! As your lovely branch, I will lend you my strength!

194.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001900_SULUIN
194.description: Well well well! If it isn't Feo Ul, the [Madbloom]! It's been too, too long!

195.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001910_FEOUL
195.description: Not long enough for you to think of any new games, though, apparently! If I were you, I'd be <hex:021A020203>bored<hex:021A020103> of myself.

196.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001920_FEOUL
196.description: Now, let me make something clear: that mortal is <hex:021A020203>mine<hex:021A020103>! No matter what you do, <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> will <hex:021A020203>never<hex:021A020103> be yours. Never, never, <hex:021A020203>ever<hex:021A020103>!

197.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001930_YSIALA
197.description: Awww, not even a bit? But...what about the others? Surely we can keep them?

198.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001940_FEOUL
198.description: No, no, no! You can't keep them either! They're for <hex:021A020203>my<hex:021A020103> amusement, and mine alone!

199.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001950_FEOUL
199.description: And if you lay so much as a finger on my sapling, I'll scatter the contents of <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> bag all over your precious village!

200.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001960_FEOUL
200.description: There'll be cold, hard metal! Furry, festering food! Stinky, sweaty smallclothes! And...and all manner of other terrible, unmentionable things! How would you like that, hmm!?

201.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001970_OULSIGUN
201.description: All right, all right... But will you not at least let us play with the twins? Just while the others go and see Urianger?

202.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001980_SULUIN
202.description: Aye, aye, that's all we ask! And we promise we'll play nicely.

203.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_001990_ALPHINAUD
203.description: ...It seems we won't be joining you.

204.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002000_YSIALA
204.description: Aye, haha! We'll reveal the hidden [truth] to you at once!

205.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002010_ALISAIE
205.description: So this is the true Il Mheg...

207.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002030_RYNE
207.description: Better. I think I remember the way now.

208.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002040_THANCRED
208.description: Apologies for the delay. Shall we go and see Urianger?

209.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002050_FEOUL
209.description: Your lovely branch is useful, yes? So whenever you're in trouble, you must remember to <hex:021A020203>make use of me<hex:021A020103>!

211.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002070_URIANGER
211.description: Unto a world weary of heroes, a hero wends <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> way...

212.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002080_URIANGER
212.description: The Exarch did send word that thou wouldst seek me out, but ne'er did I imagine thou wouldst arrive so soon...

213.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002090_URIANGER
213.description: Full glad am I to see thee once more, my friend, and none the worse for thy travails.

214.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002100_THANCRED
214.description: Run along, Minfilia. We will meet you outside.

216.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002120_THANCRED
216.description: Another one for you to imbue, if you'd be so kind.

217.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002130_URIANGER
217.description: I take it thou hast met with our other comrades already?

218.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002140_URIANGER
218.description: Hmm. That Master Alphinaud and Mistress Alisaie now travel in thy company is of great comfort to me. As for the rest...

219.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002150_URIANGER
219.description: It beginneth in earnest... The hunting of the Lightwardens, and perforce the war with Eulmore.

220.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002160_URIANGER
220.description: Hark thee, then, to my words, and through them behold the vision that I did glimpse─that of the Eighth Umbral Calamity.

221.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002170_URIANGER
221.description: As I drifted hither to the First, traversing the boundary 'twixt reality and potentiality, I did bear witness to events yet to come...

222.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002180_URIANGER
222.description: There I saw the combined forces of Eorzea and the Far East offering fierce resistance to the legions of Garlemald.

223.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002190_URIANGER
223.description: So fierce, in fact, that they did begin to push the enemy back. Ilm by painful ilm, at first, then yalm by yalm, and malm by malm in time.

224.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002200_URIANGER
224.description: Yet the joy they felt was short-lived, for in so doing, they did force the Empire's hand. Faced with defeat, the Garleans turned to a weapon most vile─Black Rose.

226.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002220_URIANGER
226.description: Once released, the gas took on a life of its own, wreaking untold carnage not only in Eorzea, but in the provinces of the Empire besides.

227.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002230_URIANGER
227.description: From fighters upon the front lines to babes in their beds, none were spared. And as the casualties became too numerous to count, so did the fabric of civilization begin to unravel.

228.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002240_URIANGER
228.description: Nor did the land itself escape unscathed. For spreading from the site of its release, Black Rose brought death to the very soil.

229.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002250_URIANGER
229.description: To survive amidst the chaos and upheaval, men came to live by the sword, the rule of law giving way, inevitably, to the rule of might.

230.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002260_URIANGER
230.description: Thus was the spark struck and the fire kindled, and swiftly did it spread, as a blaze in a field of straw, to engulf every corner of the world.

231.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002270_URIANGER
231.description: Nations worthy of the name did then cease to exist. And those souls brave and true, who might have risen to restore order...

232.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002280_URIANGER
232.description: ...were no more. For the weapon spared not one. Not even thee.

233.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002290_URIANGER
233.description: An endless age of war, begotten by the blight of Black Rose... Such is the legacy of the Eighth Umbral Calamity which I did behold.

234.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002300_URIANGER
234.description: No matter the cost, we must forestall this tragedy.

235.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002310_URIANGER
235.description: To that end, I have labored during my sojourn in this world, discovering in so doing the answer to a pressing mystery.

236.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002320_URIANGER
236.description: That of Black Rose's inexplicable potency.

240.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_A2_000_001_NONE_VOICE
240.description: It's a chart of the elements.

242.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002350_URIANGER
242.description: Indeed. 'Tis a rendering of the elemental wheel, such as one might find in classrooms across the Source.

243.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002360_URIANGER
243.description: As the chart maketh plain, our world is composed of six elements, in addition to which there exist two poles in fundamental opposition.

244.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002370_URIANGER
244.description: Astral, the active; umbral, the passive.

245.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002380_URIANGER
245.description: As a reflection of the Source, the First naturally compriseth the selfsame forces, yet curiously, there is a notable divergence in their nomenclature. To be specific, the denizens of this world employ not the terms astral and umbral.

246.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002390_URIANGER
246.description: Thus was I moved to inquire what names said forces had been assigned. A simple question which yielded a most unexpected answer...

247.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002400_URIANGER
247.description: Upon demanding the name of the pole aligned with activity and growth, I was told that as life's myriad colors combine to produce black, the people of the First had called it “Darkness.” At this did my mind begin to race.

248.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002410_URIANGER
248.description: Yet 'twas only when I asked what name had been given to the pole aligned with passivity that mine eyes were opened to the truth. Peace and tranquility being as purest white unmarred by color, I was told, it had been given the name of “Light.”

249.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002420_THANCRED
249.description: That's umbral light and astral darkness, yes? ...I'm no aetherologist, but it strikes me that the nomenclature of the First is rooted in the generation of the two forces, while our own appears to focus on their effects. Which makes one wonder...have we had it backwards all this time?

250.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002430_URIANGER
250.description: 'Tis indeed a compelling question, and one which beareth closer examination. Yet what knowledge we already possess sufficeth to explain the chain of events.

251.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002440_URIANGER
251.description: The phenomenon of aetheric thinning observed in the Source is the consequence of Light─the power of stasis─flowing in from the First to stifle the movement of aether within the land.

252.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002450_URIANGER
252.description: And according to Master Alphinaud, Black Rose slayeth by halting the circulation of aether within living beings.

253.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002460_URIANGER
253.description: Should such a weapon be unleashed even as the First were rejoined, replete as it is with Light...

254.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002470_THANCRED
254.description: ...We would have a disaster of untold proportions on our hands. A calamity.

255.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002480_THANCRED
255.description: Well...at least we have a better grasp of what we're facing. Our objective, however, remains unchanged.

256.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002490_THANCRED
256.description: We are to eliminate the Lightwarden of Il Mheg.

257.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002500_THANCRED
257.description: Speaking of which, were you able to ascertain its whereabouts?

258.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002510_URIANGER
258.description: Aye. 'Tis all but certainly ensconced within Lyhe Ghiah, the castle which standeth in the midst of the lake.

259.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002520_URIANGER
259.description: To enter said stronghold, we must needs turn to the pixies for aid. Fortunately, I have become quite adept at courting their cooperation.

260.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002530_URIANGER
260.description: Henceforth shall I accompany you, and do all in my power to ensure that my vision doth not come to pass.

261.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002540_URIANGER
261.description: 'Tis done. The pixies shall be well pleased with these gifts.

263.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002560_URIANGER
263.description: White auracite, newly forged for thy use.

264.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002570_URIANGER
264.description: Our mission being to thwart a Rejoining, we will most assuredly cross paths with those who crave the contrary. Our eternal enemies.

265.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002580_URIANGER
265.description: Thus did I choose to abide in this aether-rich land, the better to fashion a trap for the Ascians' essence.

270.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002630_THANCRED
270.description: I should probably explain. Though my body remained behind in the Source, its limitations saw fit to accompany me. Which is to say, I cannot manipulate aether.

271.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002640_THANCRED
271.description: I took up the gunblade for its defensive advantages, but on account of my little impairment, I cannot imbue the ammunition myself. Luckily for me, Minfilia has quite a talent for it.

272.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002650_URIANGER
272.description: Minfilia. Once we set forth, we are not like to return for some while. If thou wouldst choose tomes to take with thee, let it be now.

274.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002670_URIANGER
274.description: Of course, my dear. Yet have care thou dost not add overmuch to thy burden, lest I incur Thancred's ire.

275.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002680_URIANGER
275.description: Hast thou spoken to <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03> of thine encounter with the Minfilia of eld?

276.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002690_THANCRED
276.description: Well, I suppose now is as good a time as any.

277.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002700_THANCRED
277.description: As you know, I freed young Minfilia from captivity in Eulmore some three years past.

278.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002710_THANCRED
278.description: Not long after, the two of us journeyed to the south of Amh Araeng. To the edge of the Empty, where the Flood was halted.

279.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002720_THANCRED
279.description: 'Twas there that she awakened. The Minfilia of old. My Minfilia...

280.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002730_THANCRED
280.description: Tell me, tell me! What must I do to bring you back!?

281.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002740_MINFILIA
281.description: (-Oracle of Light-)My dearest Thancred... As I am now, I am no different from an Ascian. This child is but a vessel.

282.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002750_MINFILIA
282.description: (-Oracle of Light-)One of many I have used, that I might spread word of Her enduring blessing and preserve the flame of hope.

283.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002760_MINFILIA
283.description: (-Oracle of Light-)In my name, each has died never having lived her own life.

284.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002770_MINFILIA
284.description: (-Oracle of Light-)I have taken enough from these children. I will take no more.

285.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002780_THANCRED
285.description: But what of your suffering? Your sacrifice!? This isn't fair!

286.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002790_THANCRED
286.description: I will not stand for it─I cannot! There must be something we can do. Tell me!

287.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002800_MINFILIA
287.description: (-Oracle of Light-)Should the day come when this child grows weary of fighting, and wishes to cast it all aside...

288.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002810_MINFILIA
288.description: (-Oracle of Light-)Then shall I take up her burden.

289.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002820_MINFILIA
289.description: (-Oracle of Light-)But should she wish instead to become the master of her own destiny...

290.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002830_MINFILIA
290.description: (-Oracle of Light-)Then shall I bequeath to her my all.

291.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002840_MINFILIA
291.description: (-Oracle of Light-)Imbued with the strength that I reserve for rebirth, she may come to wield my powers as her own.

292.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002850_THANCRED
292.description: And what of <hex:021A020203>my<hex:021A020103> wishes!? What of F'lhaminn's!? What of all the people who love and care for you and want nothing more than to see you again!?

293.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002860_MINFILIA
293.description: (-Oracle of Light-)It is not their decision to make.

294.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002870_MINFILIA
294.description: (-Oracle of Light-)It is hers. This child's. This Minfilia's.

295.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002880_MINFILIA
295.description: (-Oracle of Light-)You have ever watched over me, Thancred.

296.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002890_MINFILIA
296.description: (-Oracle of Light-)Now I ask that you do the same for her. Protect her. Teach her. Stand by her as you stood by me.

297.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002900_MINFILIA
297.description: (-Oracle of Light-)There is much and more she does not know. She needs a guide to show her the ways of the world, or she will never find her own path.

298.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002910_MINFILIA
298.description: (-Oracle of Light-)When the time comes, you will find me here. Until that day...

301.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002940_THANCRED
301.description: ...And then she was gone. Minfilia─the girl─claims to have no recollection of any of it.

302.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002950_THANCRED
302.description: I've told her many things─where we came from, what we fight for. But of that day, I have not spoken.

304.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_A3_000_001_NONE_VOICE
304.description: How do you want this to end?

306.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002960_URIANGER
306.description: With the coming of another possessed of the blessing of Light, the First hath begun to rise up in defiance of its fate.

307.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002970_URIANGER
307.description: The question remaineth, however... Who shall take up the flame of hope which Minfilia hath borne for so long? Whether we will it or no, the choice must soon be made.

308.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002980_RYNE
308.description: I'm sorry I took so long. It was so hard to choose. In the end, I settled on just the one.

309.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_002990_URIANGER
309.description: That is well. Now, if all is in order, let us set forth for Lydha Lran.

310.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003000_SOMEONEOFFUATHA
310.description: (-Amused Fuath-)Hah hah! Well fought, well fought!

314.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003040_BOSSOFFUATH
314.description: Ohh! You do not hold back...

315.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003050_BOSSOFFUATH
315.description: But I would have it no other way! Seldom have I enjoyed such sport!

316.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003060_URIANGER
316.description: We have satisfied thy demands. Wilt thou now satisfy ours?

318.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003080_BOSSOFFUATH
318.description: There it is, the relic you seek! Yours for the taking. Have care you do not break it, though, yes?

319.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003090_BOSSOFFUATH
319.description: Ah, but you, my friend... You are mighty indeed...and pleasing to the eye besides!

320.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003100_SOMEONEOFFUATHA
320.description: (-Amused Fuath-)More! I want to see more of <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03>!

321.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003110_SOMEONEOFFUATHB
321.description: (-Mischievous Fuath-)Yes, yes! I could watch <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03> forever!

322.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003120_SOMEONEOFFUATHC
322.description: (-Enthusiastic Fuath-)Why don't we just make <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03> one of us?

324.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003140_SOMEONEOFFUATHA
324.description: One of us! One of us! One of us!

325.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003150_SOMEONEOFFUATHB
325.description: One of us! One of us! One of us!

326.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003160_SOMEONEOFFUATHC
326.description: One of us! One of us! One of us!

327.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003170_BOSSOFFUATH
327.description: Wahaha! What a fine idea! Whyever didn't I think of that!? You may have the crown...but in exchange, we will have <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103>!

328.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003180_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
328.description: Wake up! Wake up, damn you!

329.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003190_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
329.description: Oh, you're alive! Thank the gods. I don't know where you learned to breathe underwater, but it's lucky you can.

330.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003200_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
330.description: I'm sure you had your reasons, but the first rule of dealing with the Fuath...is do <hex:021A020203>not<hex:021A020103> deal with the Fuath.

331.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003210_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
331.description: It's said that they are born from the souls of the drowned. Were it not for your little trick, you'd have joined them.

332.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003220_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
332.description: Your friends are safely back on dry land, in case you were wondering. They'll be searching for you, I expect.

333.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003230_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
333.description: That's the royal capital of the Kingdom of Voeburt down there. It's seen better days.

334.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003240_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
334.description: They were a stubborn lot, the Voeburtites. Set in their ways. But once you got to know them, you couldn't find a more welcoming people.

335.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003250_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
335.description: It always froze over in winter, being up in the mountains. So we'd pull up our chairs round the fire and trade tales over steaming bowls of lamb stew, while the street lamps burned hot and bright outside...

336.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003260_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
336.description: All dead and buried now. Them and anyone else who might remember.

337.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003270_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
337.description: Everything we did...everything we <hex:021A020203>gave<hex:021A020103>... What was it for?

338.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003280_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
338.description: I wond─ I <hex:021A020203>hope<hex:021A020103> you'll have a better answer than this when all's said and done.

339.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003290_RYNE
339.description: Oh, thank goodness. There you are.

340.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003300_RYNE
340.description: Those Nu Mou were rather frightening. I'm glad you're safe.

344.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_A4_000_003_NONE_VOICE
344.description: You don't need to worry about me.

345.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003310_RYNE
345.description: I haven't seen much actual combat, so I was a little nervous, but I'm happy I could help.

346.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003320_RYNE
346.description: Thancred taught me─but I'm still a novice.

347.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003330_RYNE
347.description: No. Of course. How silly of me. You're a hero...

348.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003340_RYNE
348.description: The Minfilias before me battled sin eaters as part of the Eulmoran Army.

349.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003350_RYNE
349.description: But that had all changed by the time I was found. They held me captive so that I wouldn't follow in the others' footsteps.

350.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003360_RYNE
350.description: I'd still be in my cell now had Thancred not spirited me away. When he found me, I knew nothing of the world. I didn't know how to live, let alone fight.

351.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003370_RYNE
351.description: Thancred once told me that if the efforts to summon you failed, it would fall to me to face the Lightwardens.

352.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003380_RYNE
352.description: I realized then that it was the only reason he kept me close─as a contingency. The truth is, he can't stand to be around me.

353.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003390_RYNE
353.description: Because I'm not her. I'm not his Minfilia.

354.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003400_RYNE
354.description: ...Once, we journeyed to Nabaath Areng together. To the place where the Oracle appeared and stayed the Flood.

355.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003410_RYNE
355.description: As we drew near, I felt as though...I was fading away... I shut my eyes and covered my ears, and then... And then...

356.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003420_RYNE
356.description: I'm not sure what happened after that.

357.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003430_RYNE
357.description: I have a vague feeling that I said something to him. Only it wasn't me at all. It was <hex:021A020203>her<hex:021A020103>.

358.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003440_RYNE
358.description: Afterwards, Thancred didn't say a word. Only kept to himself and brooded.

359.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003450_RYNE
359.description: There's nothing I can do for him. Nothing I can offer but my presence─though it only reminds him of his loss.

360.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003460_RYNE
360.description: She should be the one to live on. That's why I tried to find you─because I <hex:021A020203>knew<hex:021A020103> that was what she wanted.

361.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003470_RYNE
361.description: But now that you're here...I'm not entirely sure what it was she intended me to do.

362.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003480_RYNE
362.description: Was I meant to tell you something? Or bring you to someone? Or some<hex:021A020203>where<hex:021A020103>? I can feel the answer at the edge of my mind, just out of reach─

364.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003500_OLDTITANIA
364.description: Why? Why did you imprison us?

365.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003510_OLDTITANIA
365.description: Such boredom...such <hex:021A020203>tedium<hex:021A020103> have we suffered. It is unfair! <hex:021A020203>Unfair<hex:021A020103>!

366.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003520_OLDTITANIA
366.description: Come. Come and play with us...

368.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003540_RYNE
368.description: This is everything I have. Please see it delivered to the Nu Mou.

369.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003550_RYNE
369.description: I will bear word to Thancred and the others.

370.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003560_SETO
370.description: Ah! My medallion! You found it!

371.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003570_SETO
371.description: Oh, I know not how to thank you. It is my most treasured possession─a gift from a dear, departed soul.

372.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003580_SETO
372.description: He was a traveler, and together we journeyed to the ends of the world and back again. When I was young.

373.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003590_SETO
373.description: In those days, I could not speak, but we found joy in each other's company nonetheless. Oh, the memories...

374.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003600_SETO
374.description: This medallion he found during an adventure─fashioned it into a necklace for me, his “partner in crime.”

375.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003610_SETO
375.description: I had not the words to tell him then, but it filled my heart with pride. I was so, so happy...

376.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003620_SETO
376.description: His name was Ardbert, and he was my friend.

378.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003640_SETO
378.description: Everyone blamed him for the Flood. Him and his comrades.

379.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003650_SETO
379.description: Some few spoke up for them─of the many whose lives they had touched.

380.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003660_SETO
380.description: But as the years went by, their voices were drowned out by those who only uttered the adventurers' names as a curse...

381.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003670_SETO
381.description: It was too much to bear. And so I left behind men and their lies and came to this place.

382.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003680_SETO
382.description: Ardbert was a trusting soul, constantly being drawn into the troubles of others. Yet in spite of this, he never thought twice when he saw someone in need. He always tried to help.

383.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003690_SETO
383.description: It was no different then. The world needed heroes─it needed him. And yet...

384.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003700_SETO
384.description: He was a good man. He deserved to be happy. I wish I could have told him that, at least...

386.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_A5_000_001_NONE_VOICE
386.description: I'm sure Ardbert knows how you feel.

389.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003710_SETO
389.description: You remind me of him. Your kindness...

390.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003720_SETO
390.description: When we amaro were created, we were granted the ability to perceive souls. Thus did we recognize our masters.

391.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003730_SETO
391.description: That ability has long since faded from our kind. But due perhaps to my reversion, I can see your soul. Faintly but surely.

392.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003740_SETO
392.description: It is reminiscent of Ardbert's. Strikingly so.

393.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003750_SETO
393.description: Of course, you are you, and no one else. We are defined not by the soul we are born with, but the path we walk.

394.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003760_SETO
394.description: Nevertheless...I cannot help but feel that this is more than mere coincidence...

395.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003770_SETO
395.description: ...Which is why I will place my faith in you. The relic─it is yours.

397.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003790_THANCRED
397.description: Has something happened at Lydha Lran?

398.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003800_OULSIGUN
398.description: Together with the twins, we were playing tricks on some nasty mortals to stop them from setting foot in Il Mheg.

399.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003810_OULSIGUN
399.description: At first they ran off screaming, which was lots of fun!

400.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003820_OULSIGUN
400.description: But then a scary, bony, <hex:021A020203>wrinkly<hex:021A020103> old mortal came along and spoiled everything! None of our tricks seem to work on him, which is no fun at all, and now they're getting closer and closer...

401.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003830_THANCRED
401.description: Ran'jit. If he manages to find his way in, all our efforts will have been for naught.

402.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003840_URIANGER
402.description: As thou sayest. Should we be discovered ere our mission here is complete, and the Lightwarden yet liveth, our task will be rendered nigh impossible.

403.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003850_URIANGER
403.description: If we are to prevail, we must needs divide our forces. Thus do I propose the following...

404.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003860_URIANGER
404.description: Whilst thou salliest forth to meet with the Lightwarden, we shall join in the effort to obstruct the trespassers.

405.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003870_URIANGER
405.description: Should we succeed in staying their advance, all the better. Yet even should we fail, if we can but delay our enemy's arrival long enough for thee to secure victory, our plan may still be deemed a success.

406.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003880_THANCRED
406.description: So the moment the lights go out, we all beat a hasty retreat, yes?

407.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003890_RYNE
407.description: Let me come with you! I have the blessing too!

408.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003900_THANCRED
408.description: No, Minfilia. You'll only get underfoot. Now, come.

409.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003910_RYNE
409.description: I wish there were more I could do. Please be careful...

410.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003920_FEOUL
410.description: You have freed our fallen king. Not that I expected any less, my [adorable sapling].

411.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003930_FEOUL
411.description: The dress, the crown, the scepter, the shoes─the time has come for these relics to serve their true purpose.

412.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003940_FEOUL
412.description: For they are not only keys to the castle; they are also blessings to be bestowed upon the new king.

413.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003950_FEOUL
413.description: The way into the castle is opened when it is time to relieve the reigning monarch of the throne. And the brave soul who does the deed has the honor of taking their place.

414.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003960_FEOUL
414.description: However...should you ascend the throne, you will become one of us, never again to live as men do.

415.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003970_FEOUL
415.description: My adorable sapling. My precious mortal.

416.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003980_FEOUL
416.description: We fae folk live forever, but such is not your virtue.

417.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_003990_FEOUL
417.description: To strive for a dream you will never see─to sow seeds that others might one day taste the fruits of your garden─that is the beauty of your kind.

418.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004000_FEOUL
418.description: Burn bright and shine as only you can. These blessings, your lovely branch will accept in your stead.

419.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004010_FEOUL
419.description: [Rejoice and revel, for the Kingdom of Rainbows is forever young.]

420.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004020_FEOUL
420.description: Now, shall we attend to those unwise enough to trespass in our realm?

421.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004030_ALPHINAUD
421.description: Confound it! How did they get here so fast...?

425.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004040_EULMOREADJUTANT
425.description: Damn these pixies and their tricks!

428.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004070_RANJIT
428.description: Listen well! We come in pursuit of villains who have fled to this land.

429.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004080_RANJIT
429.description: You know who and where they are. Now, show yourselves and answer me...before I lose my patience.

430.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004090_YSIALA
430.description: Owww! Stop! It hurts, it hurts!

433.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004120_RANJIT
433.description: Minfilia. Willful child. How many times must I come to collect you?

434.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004130_RYNE
434.description: I won't return to Eulmore! And I won't let you hurt my friends!

435.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004140_RANJIT
435.description: What is this stance? Where did you learn it!?

436.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004150_RANJIT
436.description: No Oracle I trained would make such an unseemly show of herself!

437.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004160_RANJIT
437.description: Know your shame, girl! You are powerless! You have no life nor purpose save that which our master sees fit to permit!

441.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004190_THANCRED
441.description: Who are you to dictate her purpose? To lock her away and deny her a life!?

442.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004200_THANCRED
442.description: If she was powerless, it's because of you, you sanctimonious swine. But no longer.

443.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004210_RANJIT
443.description: Fool. Defiance only begets more suffering. It is through acceptance alone that one may find solace in this godsforsaken world.

445.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004230_ALPHINAUD
445.description: <hex:02080CE905FF04536865FF03486503>'s done it! The Warrior of Darkness has triumphed!

446.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004240_EULMOREADJUTANT
446.description: General? What are our orders? What do we do!?

447.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004250_RANJIT
447.description: We do what we came to do. Subdue this rabble, and find the Warrior of Darkness.

448.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004260_EULMOREADJUTANT
448.description: Forward, men! Take the villains captive!

462.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004350_SOMEONEOFNUMOUA
462.description: [The night is delightful. Dance we shall!]

463.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004360_SOMEONEOFNUMOUB
463.description: [The night is delightful. Sing we shall!]

466.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004390_EULMOREADJUTANT
466.description: What's the matter with you!? Get a hold of yourselves, damn it!

467.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004400_EULMOREADJUTANT
467.description: General, they come in greater numbers! We must retreat!

468.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004410_RANJIT
468.description: All who stand with the Warrior of Darkness shall face justice! My master demands it.

469.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004420_ALISAIE
469.description: I see... Well, it's a good thing Feo Ul volunteered to become king in your stead─for all our sakes.

470.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004430_ALPHINAUD
470.description: We are grateful for your timely aid, Feo Ul─or should I say, Your Majesty.

471.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004440_FEOUL
471.description: 'Twas the first night in recent memory. We all of us but wished to make the most of it.

472.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004450_FEOUL
472.description: That's something you must remember about us fae folk. Though our existence may be eternal, we exist only for the present.

473.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004460_FEOUL
473.description: We live in the here and now, paying no mind to futures that may or may not be.

474.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004470_FEOUL
474.description: To wit, we are not driven as men are. We cannot fight for such causes as men do.

475.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004480_RYNE
475.description: Does that mean you won't aid us against the sin eaters?

476.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004490_FEOUL
476.description: Not unless the mood takes us. But if it was to repay a debt? Well then, that's another matter.

477.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004500_FEOUL
477.description: To take back as much as is taken. To create as much as is destroyed. To give as much as is received. Such is the way of Il Mheg.

478.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004510_FEOUL
478.description: By this law, we shall lend you our strength─in return for the beautiful sky you have restored to us. In times of need, do not hesitate to call.

480.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_A6_000_001_NONE_VOICE
480.description: I'll be sad to lose you.

482.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004520_FEOUL
482.description: Silly sapling, I shall remain at your side!

483.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004530_FEOUL
483.description: Even should my body be in the castle, 'tis a simple thing to have a little part of me accompany you.

484.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004540_FEOUL
484.description: Treat them as you would your [beautiful branch].

485.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004550_ALPHINAUD
485.description: All seems well at the Crystarium.

486.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004560_ALISAIE
486.description: Yes. Eulmore was plainly more concerned with finding us. How flattering.

487.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004570_EMETSELCH
487.description: (-???-)You certainly took your time. I had half-resolved to complete the task myself.

489.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004590_URIANGER
489.description: Were one to study the annals of Garlean history, one would find yonder visage on many a page.

490.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004600_URIANGER
490.description: Though by rights its youth should long since have faded.

491.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004610_EMETSELCH
491.description: (-???-)Well, well, we have a historian in our midst. That spares me a lengthy explanation.

492.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004620_EMETSELCH
492.description: (-Solus zos Galvus-)I am Solus zos Galvus, founding father of the Garlean Empire. And, under various guises, the architect of myriad other imperially inclined nations.

493.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004630_EMETSELCH
493.description: (-Solus zos Galvus-)As for my true identity...

495.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004650_ALISAIE
495.description: Gaius spoke of you! A native of the Source...

496.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004660_THANCRED
496.description: Equal in rank to Lahabrea. And you came all this way just to introduce yourself to us?

497.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004670_EMETSELCH
497.description: Behold the sky, restored to its former glory! Have you ever seen a more affecting spectacle?

499.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004690_EMETSELCH
499.description: ...Infuriating. Do you have any idea how much you have delayed the Rejoining?

500.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004700_EMETSELCH
500.description: Following the Flood, the First had been listing ever further towards the Light─towards stasis. The end was in sight!

501.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004710_EMETSELCH
501.description: Enter man and his indomitable spirit. <hex:021A020203>He<hex:021A020103> would haul the world back from the brink!

502.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004720_EMETSELCH
502.description: And adding his lumpen weight to the power of growth, he duly tipped the scales, if only by a fraction. Yet a fraction was enough to spoil the perfect imbalance needed to bring about a Rejoining!

503.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004730_EMETSELCH
503.description: Had mankind continued to live in idleness under Vauthry's rule, all the conditions would have been met...

504.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004740_EMETSELCH
504.description: But <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103> had to come and ruin it all!

505.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004741_EMETSELCH
505.description: Thanks to your meddling, Light's supremacy is in doubt, and our painstakingly laid plans are in tatters!

506.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004750_THANCRED
506.description: Well, I should begin by thanking you for confirming Urianger's theories on the inner workings of the Calamity. He will be most pleased.

507.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004760_THANCRED
507.description: As for what happens next, might I suggest you admit defeat and walk away?

508.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004770_EMETSELCH
508.description: Happy to let me go, are you? Because the murderous glint in your eye suggests otherwise. Indeed, it is enough to make me think better of confronting you alone.

509.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004780_EMETSELCH
509.description: Look, it did cross my mind to simply side with Vauthry and kill you all.

510.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004790_EMETSELCH
510.description: But that's no different from what Lahabrea did. And we all know how well that ended for him.

511.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004800_EMETSELCH
511.description: And so, while it is liable to be troublesome, I have settled upon a different approach...

513.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004820_EMETSELCH
513.description: I will not raise a hand to hinder your hunt for the Lightwardens. If you desire it, I will even lend you my knowledge and strength.

514.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004830_ALPHINAUD
514.description: Since time immemorial, you and yours have labored to rejoin the thirteen shards, at the cost of countless lives.

515.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004840_ALPHINAUD
515.description: Do you expect us to believe that your objective has suddenly changed?

516.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004850_EMETSELCH
516.description: Nay, our objective is the same as it ever was─though I daresay you do not know our motive.

517.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004860_EMETSELCH
517.description: A war waged without knowledge of the enemy is no war─it is mere bloodletting. Just once...might we not seek to find common ground?

518.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004870_EMETSELCH
518.description: For good or ill, I am immortal. Provided I have the inclination, I can always begin anew. Scheme and conspire to my heart's content.

519.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004880_EMETSELCH
519.description: But this time, I thought that I might instead try to see eye to eye. To understand what drives the hero of the Source. To determine if our goals are truly incompatible.

520.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004890_EMETSELCH
520.description: So come. Shed your preconceptions. See beyond the unscrupulous villains you take us for.

521.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004900_EMETSELCH
521.description: When all is said and done, we may find ourselves pleasantly surprised. The proud discoverers of a path of cooperation rather than opposition. Think of it.

522.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004910_URIANGER
522.description: Thou hast delivered thy proposal, and we would not dismiss it outright.

523.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004920_URIANGER
523.description: If I may offer thee counsel, however: to make thy case via an illusion reflecteth poorly upon thy sincerity.

524.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004930_EMETSELCH
524.description: My apologies. You will forgive me if I am not entirely at ease in the presence of a famed Ascian-slayer. I felt it only prudent to take precautions.

525.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004940_EMETSELCH
525.description: Nonetheless, your counsel is duly noted.

526.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004950_EMETSELCH
526.description: I take my leave, friends. Rest assured, we shall meet again soon.

527.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004960_SYSTEM_NONE_VOICE
527.description: (-Handwritten Missive-)"I hope the past few days have not been overly taxing. Pray take your rest and recover.“

528.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004970_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
528.description: From the Exarch, is it? With that mirror of his, he can watch your every move, you know. He'll probably think you're talking to yourself.

529.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004980_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
529.description: Still, he's keeping you well fed.

530.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_004990_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
530.description: Judging by his people's faith in him, he seems to be a decent sort.

531.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_005000_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
531.description: But so much about him remains shrouded in mystery. Like what was he doing back in my day? There was no such person when I was around.

532.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_005010_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
532.description: A lot's happened since the Flood, though. Since I was...set adrift. I know little more than you do of this city's history and the Exarch's past.

533.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_005020_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
533.description: Not that it matters. It's Emet-Selch we should be concerned about.

534.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_005030_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
534.description: When our world was about to be consumed by Light, the Ascian in white appeared before us. He said that the only way for us to live on was to bring about the Rejoining.

535.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_005040_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
535.description: Desperate as we were, we heeded his words, not realizing that the Flood was of the Ascians' own making.

536.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_005050_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
536.description: They cannot be trusted. None of them.

537.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_005060_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
537.description: But Emet-Selch had one thing right: one should not fight blindly.

538.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_005070_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
538.description: That's what we did. And it cost us everything we held dear.

542.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_A7_000_003_NONE_VOICE
542.description: You're putting me off my dinner.

543.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_005080_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
543.description: ...You mean Seto? Well, that's... Aye. I suppose you're right.

544.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_005090_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
544.description: He's done some growing. When we were traveling together, he was nowhere near as big.

545.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_005100_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
545.description: And he obviously couldn't speak. I had no idea how much that medallion meant to him.

546.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_005110_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
546.description: What about you, anyway? You must have a friend like Seto. Chocobo, perhaps? Come on, you tell me something for a change.

547.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_005120_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
547.description: What? What about Seto? What is there to say...? All right.

548.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_005130_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
548.description: Oh, poor you! ...But I take your point.

549.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_005140_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
549.description: Let's see, then...what's a good topic for mealtime...? Food, I suppose? I could tell you about Voeburtite cuisine, if you like.

550.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_005150_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
550.description: Oh, and there's this time we were forced to collect rare ingredients for some godsforsaken feast. If it sounds ridiculous, it's because it was.

551.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05001_005160_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
551.description: ...What? You too? Haha! Parallel worlds, eh? So what sort of things did you have to fetch, then?
